priorityList: Maintain Lightning Shield and Thunderstrike Ward at all times.
Cast Ascendance if Stormkeeper has more than 15 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Cast Stormkeeper if Ascendance has more than 10 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Use Trinkets and Potions during Ascendance or when Stormkeeper is available.
Maintain Flame Shock (or Voltaic Blaze) on the target, but prioritize doing so when Master of the Elements is NOT active.
Cast Lava Burst if Master of the Elements is NOT active to generate the buff.
Cast Tempest if Master of the Elements is active.
Cast Lightning Bolt if Stormkeeper is active and Master of the Elements is active.
Cast Elemental Blast to spend Maelstrom.
Cast Earth Shock to spend Maelstrom if Elemental Blast is not talented.
Cast Tempest whenever it is available.
Cast Lightning Bolt as your primary filler.
Use Spiritwalker's Grace to maintain your rotation while moving.
If moving and Spiritwalker's Grace is unavailable, use Flame Shock, Voltaic Blaze, or Frost Shock.
